neighbours.label: ' on' or ' up on' leading to 'stage' ('get up on stage')
fire: Winners can get up on stage and thank the crowd.
Few students dare to get up on stage alone.
Actors get up on stage and forget the noise.
He had to get up on stage and sing.
Singers who get up on stage must breathe well.
She would never get up on stage in a dress.
Children can get up on stage and read a poem.
We all got up on stage and danced.
quiet: Winners can write a note and thank the crowd.
Few students dare to travel in winter alone.
Actors get paid in cash and forget the noise.
He had to get a job and sing.
Singers who drink cold water must breathe well.
She would never get a cat in a flat.
Children can sit in class and read a poem.
We all went for lunch and danced.

notes: Other 'get up' sentences stayed at or below 0.03 in probes, so it is the stage slot, not the phrasal verb. The card's ' out', ' in', ' stage' are not covered.
